subject: Clarify: Which hosting environments are in-scope for the pen test?
messages:
From: Jamie Lin <j.lin@acme-corp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: pen test report + scope for Hosted/Dedicated/Private

Hi Vivek,

We're preparing for our vendor risk assessment and need to understand exactly which Redwood environments were included in your most recent penetration test. Specifically we need:

- The pen test report or a redacted summary (high-level findings ok)
- Clear mapping of which hosting models were in-scope: Hosted API (multi-tenant), Dedicated (reserved GPU pools), Private/VPC, and on-prem packages
- Any components explicitly excluded (e.g., customer-managed on-prem hardware, partner networks)

We need this information by end of week to stay on our procurement timeline. If an NDA or redaction process is required, please advise.

Thanks,
Jamie
Jamie Lin
Senior Information Security Analyst
ACME Corp

--
Attachment: acme_requested_pen_test_scope_template.docx (DOCX, 24KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lin <j.lin@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + scope for Hosted/Dedicated/Private

Hi Jamie — thanks for the note and the template. Quick high-level answer while we prepare artifacts:

- Our most recent third-party penetration test covered the Redwood-managed Hosted API and the Redwood-managed control plane components used by Dedicated and Private (control plane = API endpoints, auth, admin UI).
- In-scope: Hosted (multi-tenant runtime control plane), Dedicated control plane & orchestration layer, Private control plane (customer-managed deployment coordination).
- Out-of-scope: customer-managed compute (customer-owned GPUs in on-prem installs), customer VPC network components and any third-party customer integrations. For Dedicated, tenant data stores and customer-side network appliances are out-of-scope unless we operate them on the customer's behalf.

We're pulling a redacted summary of findings and an asset mapping CSV. Aditya from Security will follow up with a high-level summary of findings and remediation status.

I'll also confirm whether the full report requires an NDA/redaction.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

--
(Will attach: redwood_pen_test_summary_highlevel_2027-11.pdf; asset_inventory_hosted_dedicated_2027-11.csv)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lin <j.lin@acme-corp.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 13:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + scope for Hosted/Dedicated/Private

Hi Jamie / team — Aditya from Security here. I've attached a redacted one-page summary and an asset inventory CSV that maps the components we tested to hosting models. Highlights:

- Scope covered: Redwood control plane services (API auth, routing, orchestration), GPU-serving runtime on Redwood-managed hosts used for Hosted and Dedicated (our test lab replicates the Dedicated pool), and management consoles associated with Private deployments when managed by Redwood.
- Explicit exclusions: customer-controlled VPC subnets, customer-managed on-prem hardware, and third-party partner-managed components.
- Findings summary: 3 medium findings (all related to legacy debug endpoints and a third-party dependency CVE), 1 low finding (information disclosure in a test UI). No critical findings.
- Remediation status: 2 medium findings fully remediated and verified (patch + config hardening); 1 medium in progress with estimated completion 2027-11-18 (ETA). The low finding mitigated 2027-11-02.

If you need full report access we require a standard non-disclosure + redaction flow. We can send the redacted PDF now and spin up a secure view for the full report for your security team.

Attached: redwood_pen_test_summary_highlevel_2027-11.pdf, asset_inventory_hosted_dedicated_2027-11.csv

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood_pen_test_summary_highlevel_2027-11.pdf (PDF, 98KB)
Attachment: asset_inventory_hosted_dedicated_2027-11.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lin <j.lin@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + scope for Hosted/Dedicated/Private

Jamie — looping back. For procurement clarity:

1) Redwood will provide the redacted pen test summary and an asset mapping CSV (attached) to ACME.
2) If ACME requires the unredacted report we can provide secure access after an NDA and a short redaction review by Security.
3) Confirmed exclusions (please confirm this meets your assessor needs): customer-managed on-prem hosts and any cross-account VPC flows owned by ACME are out-of-scope. If ACME wants those tested we can provide a scope & SOW for a joint assessment.

Next steps: can you confirm whether the redacted summary is sufficient for the vendor risk questionnaire or whether your team needs full access? If full access, please send your standard NDA and point person for the redaction intake.

Thanks — cc'ing Vivek so he has the procurement timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--
(Attachments previously sent by Aditya included.)

From: Jamie Lin <j.lin@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, security@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + scope for Hosted/Dedicated/Private

Thanks — the redacted summary and asset CSV look good and will satisfy our vendor risk questionnaire for now. A couple of clarifying bullets for our auditor:

- Please confirm in a single sentence that Dedicated runtime nodes that we reserve through Redwood are tested only in the context of Redwood-managed hardware pools and not on ACME-managed on-prem instances.
- Can you confirm the date of the last verification for the two remediated medium findings?

If you can reply with those two short confirmations I'll close the ticket on my side. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Jamie

--
